core_obligations: Isom(x,y) = sheaf associated to presheaf Isom(x',y') by stackification.
Presheaf Isom(x',y') = S' x_{(y',x'),UxU} R by definition of arrows in [U/pR].
The right-hand side is an algebraic space, therefore a sheaf; sheafification does nothing.
difficulty_reason: Three-line assembly: Isom sheaf is the sheafification of the presheaf Isom (stackification construction); presheaf Isom equals the displayed fibre product by definition of morphisms in the presheaf quotient; the fibre product is an algebraic space hence a sheaf.
